page.home.title.zh: 郑凯欣 · 学习设计师

work.intro.en: Tools, structures and processes built for specific classroom problems, all of them in use.
work.intro.zh: 为具体的课堂问题而做的工具、机制和流程，目前都在使用中。

approach.leadA.en: Design thinking is a five step cycle. In a classroom, only the test settles anything.
approach.leadA.zh: 设计思维是一个五步循环。但在课堂里，真正说了算的只有「测试」。

approach.leadB.en: VocabSummit has been round this loop many times. One pass, in point form:
approach.leadB.zh: 「词山学海」已经跑过很多轮。以下是其中一轮，用要点列出：

approach.loop1Title.en: Start from something I actually saw
approach.loop1Title.zh: 从我亲眼看见的东西开始

approach.loop1P1.en: A student's comprehension paper: the passage was understood, the words were not.
approach.loop1P1.zh: 一份理解问答考卷：文章看懂了，词语没过关。

approach.loop1P2.en: The same gap turned up across the whole cohort, not one class.
approach.loop1P2.zh: 同样的缺口出现在整个级别，不只一个班。

approach.loop1P3.en: Students will not humour anything that wastes their time. That is the real constraint.
approach.loop1P3.zh: 学生不会迁就浪费他们时间的东西。这才是真正的限制。

approach.loop2Title.en: Name the gap in one sentence

approach.loop2P1.en: The problem is vocabulary, not comprehension.

approach.loop2P2.en: It has to cover G1, G2, G3 and Higher Chinese, at different depths.
approach.loop2P2.zh: 必须覆盖 G1、G2、G3 与高级华文，深浅不同。

approach.loop2P3.en: It works if a student practises without being told to.
approach.loop2P3.zh: 成功的标准：没人叫他，学生也会去练。

approach.loop3Title.en: Design the motivation, not just the content
approach.loop3Title.zh: 设计的是动机，不只是内容

approach.loop3P1.en: Motivation built into the structure from the start: Self-Determination Theory, Assessment for Learning.
approach.loop3P1.zh: 动机一开始就放进结构里：自我决定理论（SDT）、促进学习的评价（AfL）。

approach.loop3P2.en: Students choose scope and difficulty. Nothing is assigned.
approach.loop3P2.zh: 范围和难度由学生自己选，不由系统分配。

approach.loop3P3.en: The name carries the design: a mountain you can see yourself climbing. Visible progress, streaks, a personal map.
approach.loop3P3.zh: 名字本身就是设计：一座看得见自己在爬的山。进度看得见，有连续挑战，有个人地图。

approach.loop4Title.en: Build the thing, not a picture of it
approach.loop4Title.zh: 做出东西来，而不是画一张示意图

approach.loop4P1.en: A working build on Firebase, not a mockup, with no formal software engineering training behind it.
approach.loop4P1.zh: 一个真能跑的版本，后端用 Firebase，不是示意图；做的人没受过软件工程的正规训练。

approach.loop4P2.en: 3,741 vocabulary entries, vetted by hand, one at a time.

approach.loop4P3.en: In front of students within days of being usable, not at the end of a term.
approach.loop4P3.zh: 勉强能用就送到学生面前，几天之内，而不是等到学期末。

approach.loop5Title.en: The classroom is the test, not the demo
approach.loop5Title.zh: 课堂才是测试，演示不是

approach.loop5P1.en: Three classes beta tested it. 47 students gave feedback.
approach.loop5P1.zh: 三个班参与测试，47 名学生给了反馈。

approach.loop5P2.en: Colleagues nodding at a demo is not evidence. Students working independently in an ordinary lesson is.
approach.loop5P2.zh: 同事在演示时点头，不算证据；学生在一堂普通的课上自己用，才算。

approach.loop5P3.en: Which words keep failing, which screen nobody visits, which instruction I repeat every time. Those are the design documents.
approach.loop5P3.zh: 哪些词一错再错，哪个页面没人去，哪一句指示我每次都得再讲一遍。这些才是设计文档。

approach.loopClose.en: Then round again, from the top. Every version of VocabSummit so far came out of one more pass, and each pass starts from a better question than the last.
approach.loopClose.zh: 然后再从头跑一遍。「词山学海」的每一个版本，都是又跑了一圈的结果；每一圈的起点，都是一个比上一圈更好的问题。

colophon.source.zh: 本站中文名，语出《易经 · 系辞》

page.nlc26.title.en: 2026 AI in Sec CL NLC - Chun Kai Xin
page.nlc26.title.zh: 2026 AI in Sec CL NLC · 郑凯欣

nlc26.title.en: Splitting heaven and earth with an AI axe — how VocabSummit got built
nlc26.title.zh: 挥舞AI之斧开天辟地 —— 词山学海的创作现场

nlc26.epigraphSrc.en: Lu Xun, My Old Home · this community's own motto
nlc26.epigraphSrc.zh: 鲁迅《故乡》· 本学习社群的题词

nlc26.handsTitle.en: Hands-on: your spreadsheet to a live link
nlc26.handsTitle.zh: 动手环节：从你的词语表到一个网址

nlc26.handsLede.en: Excel → Claude → GitHub Pages. All in the browser. No install, no terminal, no coding.
nlc26.handsLede.zh: Excel → Claude → GitHub Pages。全程在浏览器里，不必装东西，不必碰终端机，不必会编码。

nlc26.step1P1.en: The starter has 词语表模板.xlsx and a .csv. Two columns, 词语 and 释义. Leave row 1 alone.
nlc26.step1P1.zh: 示范项目里有「词语表模板.xlsx」和一份 .csv。两栏：词语、释义。第一行不要动。

nlc26.step1P2.en: Eight entries or more. You never write wrong answers: distractors come from your other entries.
nlc26.step1P2.zh: 8 个以上。错误选项不用你写，程序会从你其他词语的释义里抓。

nlc26.step2P1.en: Green Code button → Download ZIP → unzip.
nlc26.step2P1.zh: 绿色的 Code 按钮 → Download ZIP → 解压。

nlc26.step2P2.en: About 540KB. On a slow network, take it off a thumb drive instead.
nlc26.step2P2.zh: 大约 540KB。网络慢的话，直接用随身碟拷。

nlc26.step3Title.en: Give both to a Claude Project
nlc26.step3Title.zh: 把两样都交给 Claude Project

nlc26.step3P1.en: claude.ai → Projects → new one. Upload the whole game folder AND your spreadsheet.
nlc26.step3P1.zh: claude.ai → Projects → 新建一个。把整个游戏资料夹和你的词语表都上传进去。

nlc26.step3P2.en: A Project keeps those files. Next term, same Project, one sentence, done.
nlc26.step3P2.zh: Project 会把文件留着。下个单元回到同一个 Project 说一句就行，不必重传。

nlc26.step3P3.en: Paste the prompt below. The last line is the important one: you want it to report problems, not paper over them.
nlc26.step3P3.zh: 把下面这段贴进去。最后一句最要紧：你要它先报告问题，而不是替你蒙混过去。

nlc26.step4Title.en: Swap the file in and look at it

nlc26.step4P1.en: Put Claude's my-words.js back in the folder, replacing the old one. Double-click index.html.
nlc26.step4P1.zh: 把 Claude 给你的 my-words.js 放回资料夹，覆盖原来那个。双击 index.html。

nlc26.step4P2.en: Play one round and read your own questions. This checking step is the actual skill.
nlc26.step4P2.zh: 玩一局，看看自己出的题。这一步的检查，才是真正要学的本事。

nlc26.step5Title.en: Publish it as a link for students
nlc26.step5Title.zh: 变成一个网址，发给学生

nlc26.step5P1.en: github.com/new → name it → Public → Create repository.
nlc26.step5P1.zh: github.com/new → 取个名字 → 选 Public → Create repository。

nlc26.step5P2.en: Click uploading an existing file, then drag your whole folder in, art folder included. Commit changes. No Git, no terminal.
nlc26.step5P2.zh: 点 uploading an existing file，把整个资料夹拖进去，连 art 资料夹一起。Commit changes。不必装 Git，不必用终端机。

nlc26.step5P3.en: Settings → Pages → Deploy from a branch → main → / (root) → Save. Wait a minute or two.
nlc26.step5P3.zh: Settings → Pages → Deploy from a branch → 选 main → 选 /(root) → Save。等一两分钟。

nlc26.step5P4.en: https://yourusername.github.io/yourreponame/ — free, no ads, no cap. To change words later, edit my-words.js on the GitHub page itself.
nlc26.step5P4.zh: https://你的用户名.github.io/你的仓库名/ — 免费，没广告，不限人数。以后要换词语，直接在 GitHub 网页上改 my-words.js。

nlc26.stuck1.en: Blank page, or 词语表好像有点问题: the message names the line. Almost always a missing comma, quote, or brace.
nlc26.stuck1.zh: 页面空白，或跳出「词语表好像有点问题」：提示会写第几行。九成是少了逗号、引号或大括号。

nlc26.stuck2.en: Can't find Claude's file: look in Downloads, then drag it back into the game folder.
nlc26.stuck2.zh: 找不到 Claude 给的文件：看「下载 / Downloads」资料夹，再拖回游戏资料夹。

nlc26.stuck3.en: GitHub Pages shows 404: it needs a minute or two. Then hard refresh, Cmd+Shift+R or Ctrl+F5.
nlc26.stuck3.zh: GitHub Pages 是 404：要等一两分钟。然后强制刷新（Cmd+Shift+R / Ctrl+F5）。

nlc26.stackLede.en: Four things, each handling one part. Independent: you can use only one.
nlc26.stackLede.zh: 四样东西各管一段，彼此独立，只用其中一样也可以。

nlc26.p1A.en: It is not a chatbot that hands you a snippet to paste. It reads the files in your project, edits them, runs the result, and checks whether it worked.
nlc26.p1A.zh: 它不是给你一段代码让你贴的聊天机器人。它会直接读你项目里的文件、动手改、跑起来，再自己看对不对。

nlc26.p1B.en: Your job shifts from writing code to saying clearly what you want, then judging whether what came back is right. That second half is what teachers are already good at.
nlc26.p1B.zh: 你的工作从「写代码」变成「说清楚要什么」加「判断做出来的对不对」。后面那半，正是教师本来就擅长的事。

nlc26.p1C.en: Saying it clearly beats saying it elegantly. What is it for, who uses it, and what counts as working. Same three questions as a good task instruction.
nlc26.p1C.zh: 讲清楚比讲漂亮重要：这东西要做什么、给谁用、怎样才算做对了。跟给学生写一份好的作业指示，是同一回事。

nlc26.p2A.en: The rock face, the landscape and the climbing character in today's game were all generated. None of it was bought or licensed.
nlc26.p2A.zh: 今天这个游戏里的山壁、风景、会爬的角色，全都是生成出来的，没有一样是买的。

nlc26.p2B.en: Generating art is not wishing, it is writing a specification. A character strip has to be stated exactly: six frames in a row, every cell the same width and height, facing right, plain magenta background, and no text or numbers anywhere.
nlc26.p2B.zh: 生成图像不是许愿，是写规格。一张角色动作图必须说死：六格横向并排、每一格等宽等高、角色朝右、纯洋红色背景、画面上不准出现任何文字或数字。

nlc26.p2C.en: Get the specification wrong and the image simply will not fit into the game. This is the single most transferable habit of the four.
nlc26.p2C.zh: 规格说不清楚，图就是拼不进游戏里。四件事当中，这一件最容易迁移到日常教学。

nlc26.p3A.en: Every change is recorded, so a change that breaks something can be rolled back. That history, not the storage, is what hosting is actually worth.
nlc26.p3A.zh: 每一次改动都留下记录，改坏了可以退回去。托管真正值钱的不是「存着」，是这份历史。

nlc26.p3B.en: GitHub Pages turns the repository into a web address for free. No ads, no cap on how many students open it, nothing for them to install.
nlc26.p3B.zh: GitHub Pages 免费把它变成一个网址。没有广告，不限多少学生打开，学生那边什么都不用装。

nlc26.p3C.en: Some school networks block github.com. The workaround is a phone hotspot, but the thing that matters is knowing about it before you are standing in front of a class.
nlc26.p3C.zh: 有些学校的网络会挡 github.com。解决办法是手机热点，但真正重要的是事先知道有这回事，别站在班上才发现。

nlc26.p4A.en: This is the part that knows who is who: students sign in, progress is saved, it follows them to another device, and a leaderboard becomes possible.
nlc26.p4A.zh: 这一块管的是「谁是谁」：学生登录、进度存下来、换一台电脑还在、排行榜也才做得起来。

nlc26.p4B.en: The cost is that you now own something. Where the data sits, who can see it, what school and ministry policy says, and who maintains it after you.
nlc26.p4B.zh: 代价是你多了一样要负责的东西：数据存在哪里、谁看得到、学校和教育部的规定怎么说、以后由谁来维护。

nlc26.p4C.en: We are not building this today, on purpose. Most classroom tools do not need accounts at all. Build the version that needs no login first, and add this only when you genuinely need it.
nlc26.p4C.zh: 今天故意不动手做这一块。大部分课堂工具其实根本不需要账号。先做不用登录的版本，真的需要了再加。

nlc26.stackClose.en: You just used the first and the third by doing them. The second is one optional step inside the same Project. The fourth we only talk about.
nlc26.stackClose.zh: 第一样和第三样，你刚才动手用过了。第二样是同一个 Project 里的一个选做步骤。第四样今天只谈，不做。

nlc26.q1.en: Where does student data go? Is this compliant?
nlc26.q1.zh: 学生数据放在哪里？合规吗？

nlc26.q1A.en: It depends on what you build. Today's game collects nothing at all: no login, no server, nothing left behind when a student closes the tab. That version raises no data question.
nlc26.q1A.zh: 看你做什么。今天这个游戏什么都不收：没有登录、没有服务器，学生关掉网页就什么都不留。这种版本没有数据问题。

nlc26.q1B.en: The moment you add accounts and saved progress, data sits on a third party's servers. Which region it sits in, who can read it, and how long it is kept all have to follow school and ministry rules.
nlc26.q1B.zh: 一旦加上账号和进度储存，数据就落在第三方的服务器上。存在哪个地区、谁读得到、保存多久，都要照学校和教育部的规定走。

nlc26.q1C.en: The order that works: build the version that collects nothing, use it, and only take on the compliance conversation once you genuinely need to track progress. Doing it the other way round stalls for months.
nlc26.q1C.zh: 行得通的顺序是：先做不收数据的版本，先用起来，等到真的需要追踪进度了，再去谈合规。反过来做，往往一拖好几个月。

nlc26.q2.en: With no IT support, who maintains it?
nlc26.q2.zh: 没有 IT 支援，以后谁来维护？

nlc26.q2A.en: A static page, which is HTML plus images, needs almost no maintenance. On GitHub Pages it can sit untouched for years and still work.
nlc26.q2A.zh: 一个静态网页（就是 HTML 加图片）几乎不用维护。放在 GitHub Pages 上，几年不动它也照样能开。

nlc26.q2B.en: What needs maintaining is the other kind: accounts, databases, logins. Which is the practical argument for not adding them unless you must.
nlc26.q2B.zh: 需要维护的是另一类：有账号、有数据库、要登录的。这正是「能不加就不加」的现实理由。

nlc26.q2C.en: Because the code lives on GitHub rather than on your laptop, a colleague can pick it up if you move schools. That is safer than the folder on your desktop.
nlc26.q2C.zh: 代码放在 GitHub 上而不是你的手提电脑里，你调职了同事也接得下去。这比存在自己桌面上的文件夹安全得多。

nlc26.q3.zh: 学校发的电脑做得到吗？

nlc26.q3A.en: For today's hands-on, yes. It needs a browser and a plain text editor, and every machine already has both.
nlc26.q3A.zh: 今天的动手环节可以。只需要一个浏览器和一个纯文本编辑器，这两样每台电脑本来就有。

nlc26.q3B.en: The step that installs software, running Claude Code locally, may be restricted on a managed device. There is a browser version, or you can use your own machine.
nlc26.q3B.zh: 要安装软件的那一步（在本机跑 Claude Code）在受管制的设备上可能装不了。可以改用网页版，或者用自己的设备。

nlc26.q3C.en: github.com is sometimes blocked on the school network. Knowing that in advance is the difference between a workaround and a panic.
nlc26.q3C.zh: 学校网络有时候会挡 github.com。事先知道，就只是换个方法；当场才发现，就会慌。

nlc26.q4.en: I cannot code at all. Can I really do this?
nlc26.q4.zh: 我完全不会编码，真的做得到吗？

nlc26.q4A.en: Today's hands-on, yes. It was designed from the start around someone who does not code.
nlc26.q4A.zh: 今天这个动手环节可以。它从一开始就是照着「不会编码的人」来设计的。

nlc26.q4B.en: Building something the size of VocabSummit does not need coding ability either. It needs the patience to keep saying clearly what you want, and the judgement to tell whether what came back is right. Teachers do both of those every day.
nlc26.q4B.zh: 做一个像词山学海那样规模的东西，需要的也不是编码能力，而是「愿意反复把要什么讲清楚」加上「判断做出来的东西对不对」。这两件事教师每天都在做。

nlc26.q4C.en: It would be dishonest to make it sound effortless. It takes time, you will get stuck, and some evenings produce nothing. It is about the same order of work as preparing a whole new unit from scratch.
nlc26.q4C.zh: 但也不必美化：会花时间，会卡住，会有几个晚上什么都做不出来。这跟从零备一套全新的单元，工作量差不多。

nlc26.padletLede.en: On the NLC's own shared Padlet, the link to which you already have. Find the section named 20260828 百德中学「词山学海」工作坊.
nlc26.padletLede.zh: 在 NLC 本身的共享 Padlet 上，网址各位手上都有。请找「20260828 百德中学『词山学海』工作坊」这个栏目。

nlc26.padletP1.en: What I built: post a screenshot of your word list, or your live URL if you deployed it.
nlc26.padletP1.zh: 我的成果：把你的词语表截图贴上来；如果你部署了，就贴网址。

nlc26.padletP2.en: Where I am stuck: paste the error message or a screenshot. No need to wait to be called on.
nlc26.padletP2.zh: 卡住的地方：把错误讯息或截图贴上来，不必等举手。

nlc26.padletP3.en: What I would try back at school: one line is enough. We will use these in the discussion.
nlc26.padletP3.zh: 回校后想试什么：一句话就够，讨论环节会用到。

nlc26.dVenue.zh: 地点 · 中正中学（总校）

nlc26.dAudience.en: Audience · the 2026 AI in Sec CL NLC: 18 Secondary Chinese Language teachers, 16 schools, 13 clusters
nlc26.dAudience.zh: 对象 · 2026 AI in Sec CL NLC：13个学区、16所学校、18位中学华文教师

nlc26.dSpeaker.en: Speaker · Chun Kai Xin, Head of Mother Tongue, Bukit View Secondary School
nlc26.dSpeaker.zh: 主讲 · 郑凯欣，百德中学母语部主任

nlc26.vsP1.en: A Secondary Chinese Language vocabulary platform: students climb, answer, and unlock characters.
nlc26.vsP1.zh: 中学华文词语平台：学生爬山、答题、解锁角色。

nlc26.vsP2.en: 攀山快答, the mode you adapt today, was rewritten as one readable file so a teacher can change it.
nlc26.vsP2.zh: 今天动手改的「攀山快答」是其中一个模式，重写成单一文件，让老师改得动。

nlc26.vsP3.en: It began with one comprehension paper: the passage understood, the words not.
nlc26.vsP3.zh: 起点是一份理解问答考卷：文章看懂了，词语没过关。

nlc26.afterP1.en: Built something back at school? Send it to me.
nlc26.afterP1.zh: 回校做出了什么，发给我看看。

nlc26.afterP2.en: Stuck halfway? Ask then, not after you have given up.
nlc26.afterP2.zh: 做到一半卡住，当下就问，别等放弃了才说。

nlc26.afterP3.en: The starter is MIT licensed: adapt it, use it in class, rework it for another subject. Keep the attribution. Art assets included.
nlc26.afterP3.zh: 示范项目 MIT 许可：自由改编、用于课堂、改成别科皆可，保留署名即可。美术素材一并提供。

nlc26.step4P3.en: Want more changed? Keep talking to it: title, colours, timer, the gap between ledges.
nlc26.step4P3.zh: 还想改别的就接着说：标题、颜色、秒数、落脚点之间的高度。

nlc26.fallbackLabel.en: No account, or the network is blocked?

nlc26.fallback1.en: You do not need Claude for this. Open my-words.js in Notepad or TextEdit and type your words straight in.
nlc26.fallback1.zh: 不必用 Claude 也行。用记事本或「文本编辑」打开 my-words.js，直接把词语打进去。

nlc26.fallback2.en: That path needs no account and no network at all, and gives you exactly the same working game.
nlc26.fallback2.zh: 这条路不需要账号，也不需要网络，做出来的游戏一模一样。

nlc26.fallback3.en: Only step 5, the public link, truly needs an account. Everything before it runs on your own laptop.
nlc26.fallback3.zh: 只有第五步（公开网址）真的需要账号。前面全都在你自己的电脑上跑。

nlc26.stuck4.en: School network blocks github.com or claude.ai: phone hotspot, or do it at home. The offline path above still works.
nlc26.stuck4.zh: 学校网络挡住 github.com 或 claude.ai：用手机热点，或回家再弄。上面那条离线的路照样能走。
